note: Weekly per-game PPR projections: season ppg x opponent def-vs-pos multiplier (PPR allowed/gm vs league avg — def-vs-pos from 2025 (no 2026 weeks yet; blends in-season at n/(n+6)) — deviation shrunk to 40% of observed, clamped [0.82,1.18]) x home/away (1.02/0.98), normalized to mean 1.0 per team so weeks sum to the season line. null = bye. Points assume the player plays; gp carries the season games discount. Half/Std: pts - 0.5*rec or pts - rec, where weekly rec scales with the same multiplier (rec_w = recPG * pts_w / ppg). gsis/sleeper ids stamped from the player crosswalk (null when the player has no NFL gsis yet). K/DST (one per team): season line = league avg + shrunk team deviation (0.5/0.4); K rows use the current depth-chart PK1 (own prior PPG blended 50/50 when >=8 games); K scoring FG 3/4/5 by distance + XP; DST scoring sack 1 / INT 2 / fum rec 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 + standard points-allowed brackets; defVsPos[T].K = K pts defense T allows, defVsPos[T].DST = DST pts offense T concedes. Sleeper DST id = team code.
